name: branch-warning
description: Permanent staging provenance warnings and view-only branch reminders in the VS Code status bar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads local Git metadata and runs read-only Git commands.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/git.js && node --check src/tracker.js && node --check src/presentation.js && node --check src/storage.js

branchWarning.enabled.description: Show branch warnings and monitor new Git activity while this VS Code window is open. Existing permanent warnings are retained when disabled.

branchWarning.forbiddenBranches.description: Exact forbidden base branch names. Creating a branch from one, merging one, or rebasing onto one permanently flags the feature branch. Named remote refs such as origin/staging are recognized too.

branchWarning.viewOnlyBranches.description: Exact branch names that show the same amber view-only reminder. This is a visual reminder; commits and merges remain available.

branchWarning.pollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between checks for Git activity from VS Code, terminals, and other Git apps.
